summary: Defines a SiteDocument with simple fields for ID and SiteID.
purpose: Represents a document related to a site within the system.

summary: Welcome page for staff/admin panel showing last login, error handling, and filtering of employment applications by dates, site, and discipline.
purpose: To display a filtered, paged list of student employment applications to staff/admins with date and site/discipline filtering and status handling.

workflows.name: View/Filter Employment Applications
steps: User selects Site and Discipline filter (with All available).
System binds grid to show matching applications with status, email, site, program, and withdrawal info.

business_rules: Employment applications are filtered by selected site, discipline, and date range.
Withdrawn applications can optionally be included/excluded.
validations: Start and End dates are required.
Start date must be before or equal to End date.
Dates must match a valid date format.
conditions: If withdrawn date is set, status shows as Withdrawn, otherwise Submitted.
If last login is available, display it, otherwise hide that panel.
system_behavior: On postback, maintains view state for filters.
Supports AJAX update panel for partial page refreshes.
Displays errors and warnings if present.
exceptions: If UserSession is empty, data query is cancelled.
If filter dates invalid, display validation error and do not refresh data.

summary: Service codes represent codified, localizable categories for use in various business operations in the system.
purpose: Allow selection and localization of service codes for courses, timetables, etc.

workflows.name: List Service Codes By Context
steps: Call ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID or ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID for context-specific options.
Localize Name/Notes fields if using an alternate language.

business_rules: Use alt language fields if session is in alt language mode.
system_behavior: Returns all codes in order, localized as needed.
dependencies: Database stored procedures: ServiceCodeListAll, ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID, ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID

summary: Tracks and displays a historical log of edits and actions performed on site profiles.
purpose: Audit and display site profile changes, including who performed them and when.

workflows.name: View Site Profile History
steps: User control requests history for SiteID and SessionAgencyID.
Tooltip/Details show formatted user and agency info.

business_rules: If user is system admin or acting for another, notation is added.
conditions: Values use alt language fields if session is in alt language mode.
system_behavior: Returns a list of actions, localized and formatted.
Supports UI tooltips and labels for user/agency details.

summary: Represents documents attached or shown in email popups, supporting CRUD operations.
purpose: Allow managing and deleting documents shown in email popups.

workflows.name: Manage Email Popup Documents
steps: Parse DataInfo string to construct document list.
Select document for delete by ID.
Delete file and containing directory if possible.

business_rules: On delete, both the file and folder are deleted if present.
system_behavior: Safe deletion is attempted (exceptions silently handled).

summary: Legacy VBScript/ASP page for anonymous student enrollment search.
purpose: Entry point for screen rendering of anonymous enrollment student search.
content_gaps: Implementation details are in DoScreen.asp include, which is not present in the retrieved content.
